title: Private Surf Lesson in North Myrtle Beach
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn to surf with Kokopelli Surf Camp in Myrtle Beach or North Myrtle Beach and have the most awesome experience of your life! The only surf camp where you can learn from professional surfers on boards designed for learning. Our professional surfers with years of experience ensure you learn not only the right way to surf but a passion for the sport as well. With each lesson, we guarantee to get you riding waves. Instructors, CPR and First Aid certified create a fun safe environment to learn surfing by assisting the students while entering the water, catching waves, and much more. Learn to surf like the local pros.
